mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_news WHERE ext_id = #{extId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_news (ext_id, title, url, source, published_at, status) VALUES (#{extId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{source}, #{publishedAt}, 'RECEIVED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, ext_id, title, url, source, published_at, fetched_at, status FROM stock_news WHERE status = 'RECEIVED' ORDER BY fetched_at DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT id, ext_id, title, url, source, published_at, fetched_at, status, targets, sentiment, rationale, kind, model, expires_at FROM stock_news WHERE status = 'ANALYZED' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
AND ',' || targets || ',' LIKE '%,' || #{key} || ',%'
ORDER BY COALESCE(published_at, fetched_at) DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT sentiment FROM stock_news WHERE status = 'ANALYZED' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND sentiment IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(published_at, fetched_at) DESC

SELECT id, ext_id, title, url, source, published_at, fetched_at, status, targets, sentiment, rationale, kind, model, expires_at, facts FROM stock_news WHERE kind = 'EVENT' AND fetched_at >= #{since} AND (sentiment LIKE '%S4%' OR sentiment LIKE '%S5%')
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_news SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ANALYZED' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, ext_id, title, url, source, published_at, fetched_at, status, targets, sentiment, rationale, kind, model, expires_at, facts FROM stock_news WHERE ',' || targets || ',' LIKE '%,' || #{symbol} || ',%' AND COALESCE(published_at, fetched_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
